note: golden_hash filled by golden-parity.test.mjs --update. ART365-GLOBE-FIX-1 (2026-08-16) rewrote vectors 2-5 and the note text of vectors 1/6 to correct four divergences from the pinned OECD Side-by-Side Package (Ch5) independently CONFIRMED by ART365-DIVERGENCE-CONFIRM-1: (1) SbS Safe Harbour deems Top-up Tax zero for BOTH IIR and UTPR, not routed to UTPR; (2) eligibility runs on a declared Central Record listing, never a hardcoded parentHq===US; (3) requires a declared Filing CE election; (4) does not apply before fiscal years commencing 1 January 2026.

vectors.name: de_parent_iir_allocation
vectors.description: DE/IE/SG at fy2026, parent_hq DE with no Central Record listing and no election declared: SbS Safe Harbour does not apply. DE ETR 14% -> top_up 4.662, fully absorbed by QDMTT. IE ETR 10% -> top_up 9.374, fully absorbed by QDMTT. SG ETR 12% -> top_up 4.1508, no QDMTT enacted, so full residual routes to IIR.

output_payload.regulatory_basis: OECD Pillar Two GloBE Model Rules (Dec 2021) + GloBE Commentary (Mar 2022) + Administrative Guidance (2023-2024) + OECD/G20 Inclusive Framework Side-by-Side Package (approved/declassified 5 January 2026) Ch5 SbS Safe Harbour
output_payload.note: SBIE payroll rate defaults to the OECD transitional table for fy when not supplied; the tangible-assets SBIE rate is held at the published steady-state 5% regardless of fy, matching the source tools. Jurisdiction-level qdmtt_rate/qdmtt_enacted are caller-supplied, not vendored. The SbS Safe Harbour (us_exempt, keeping the legacy field name) requires all three of a declared Central Record listing (central_record_sbs), a declared Filing CE election (sbs_election), and a fiscal year on or after 2026 -- it is never inferred from parent_hq alone, and when it applies the Top-up Tax for that jurisdiction is deemed zero for both the IIR and the UTPR, not routed between them.

vectors.name: sbs_eligible_parent_zero_topup
vectors.description: ART365-GLOBE-FIX-1 (2026-08-16), replaces us_parent_utpr_allocation: SAME DE/IE/SG jurisdictions, parent_hq US, ON the Central Record for a Qualified SbS Regime, Filing CE election made, fy2026 (on/after the para-28 effective date). Ch5 box item 1 + para 8 deem the jurisdiction Top-up Tax ZERO for BOTH the IIR and the UTPR -- the OLD vector expected utpr_collected 4.1508 (residual re-routed to UTPR), CONFIRMED WRONG by ART365-DIVERGENCE-CONFIRM-1 claim 1; corrected expectation is iir_collected 0 AND utpr_collected 0 on every row. QDMTT collection (14.036 total) is unaffected.
